dune_followup_research.status: Research and source inspection only; not added to delivered build
dune_followup_research.current_source: LandscapeProvince.HeightOffset uses two fixed planetary wave families with curved crests and a steep lee face. Its second family prevents radial degeneration; it is not a classification of regional dune types.
dune_followup_research.design_direction: Use stable regional sediment availability, vegetation anchoring and long-term wind-direction diversity to choose coherent dune fields. Add finite crescent forms, multidirectional star forms and vegetated parabolic margins instead of making every sand sea a variant of continuous parallel ridges. Instant weather gusts should not reshape terrain.
dune_followup_research.source_findings: The NPS distinguishes reversing dunes from opposing winds, star dunes from multiple wind directions, barchan dunes in one-direction low-vegetation settings, and parabolic dunes with vegetation-held arms.
dune_followup_research.review_gate: Inspect actual ground-level profiles and broad field silhouettes under the same noon lighting. Keep common water/root/material sampling and existing moving/loading budgets; no extra scenery mesh or per-frame erosion is proposed.

shading_followup_audit.status: Source inspection only; no runtime change, extra test or new visual-fix claim
shading_followup_audit.observation: Fine boundary positions collapse onto coarse triangle edges, but normals still use a central difference at each tile's own step. That up value also drives geology weights and ground/forest cover. Shared boundary positions therefore do not by themselves guarantee matching normals or material attributes at different detail levels.
shading_followup_audit.next_step: Capture a pinned mixed-detail boundary with geometry, unlit colour and normal views separated. Compare actual coarse/fine shared endpoint attributes before choosing a bounded interpolation or common-derivative solution.
shading_followup_audit.constraints: Do not blindly add four full terrain samples per vertex. Preserve physical height, water, root admission and the sparse-backdrop loading improvement. Check corners and changing neighbors, then repeat moving frame tails and loading before promotion.
